paper.title_en: The Universality of Halo Growth and Merger Rates in Modified Gravity Theories
paper.abstract_en: In the standard $Λ$CDM framework, the merger rate of dark matter haloes has been found to follow a nearly universal form, with only weak dependence on halo mass and redshift. We examine whether this universality is preserved in modified gravity (MG) models, where the growth of cosmic structure can deviate from that of general relativity (GR). We use the ELEPHANT suite of large $N$-body simulations to study halo merger rates and mass accretion histories in different modified gravity models, including two representative scenarios beyond-GR: the Hu--Sawicki chameleon $f(R)$ model and the normal branch of the Dvali--Gabadadze--Porrati model. For the mass accretion histories, the modified gravitational effect can produce systematic departures from GR, generally corresponding to more rapid halo growth. The deviations are relatively small when the MG effect is weak, while they become more pronounced in models with strong deviation from GR and can exceed $15\%$ in the extreme case. For the halo merger rate, we find that the nearly universal behavior is well preserved across all the gravity models, with only weak dependence on redshift and halo mass, reflecting the unbiased accretion nature of halo growth. However, apparent deviation from this universality can arise if the halo mass is not defined consistently with the modified gravity model.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文利用大规模N体模拟（ELEPHANT套件）系统比较Hu-Sawicki f(R)与nDGP模型下暗晕并合率与质量吸积历史的普适性，属于修改引力主题下的结构形成研究，方法清楚、结果明确，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 修改引力理论中暗晕增长与并合率的普适性
decision.abstract_zh: 在标准$\Lambda$CDM框架下，暗物质晕的并合率已被发现遵循一种近乎普适的形式，仅对晕质量和红移有微弱依赖。我们检验这种普适性在修改引力（MG）模型中是否保持，在这些模型中宇宙结构的增长可能偏离广义相对论（GR）。我们使用ELEPHANT大规模$N$体模拟套件，研究不同修改引力模型中的暗晕并合率与质量吸积历史，包括两个有代表性的超出GR的情形：Hu--Sawicki变色龙$f(R)$模型与Dvali--Gabadadze--Porrati模型的正常分支。对于质量吸积历史，修改的引力效应可以产生对GR的系统性偏离，一般对应于更快的暗晕增长。当MG效应较弱时偏离相对较小，而在偏离GR较强的模型中偏离更为显著，在极端情形下可超过$15\%$。对于暗晕并合率，我们发现这种近乎普适的行为在所有引力模型中均得到良好保持，仅对红移和晕质量有微弱依赖，这反映了暗晕增长的无偏吸积性质。然而，如果暗晕质量未按与修改引力模型一致的方式定义，则可能出现对这种普适性的表观偏离。
